QuestInfo.name: Arkarium's Barrier
QuestInfo.1:
You must find the reagents necessary to bring down Arkarium's barrier spell.

How to destroy the barrier

1. Retrieve the Lambent Essence from Neinheart.
2. Collect 50 Dragon Warrants from the monsters around Leafre, Dragon Forest.

0.0: I think it's too dangerous to get into that passage right now. Arkarium's a really powerful wizard and my hiding abilities don't really help much when a crazy old guy is throwing fireballs around.
0.1: Do you think you could break Arkarium's warding spells? If you can, maybe all his guards won't notice when we come down after him!
0.2: So, I guess your next job would be to break into the Dimensional Schism!

yes.0: First off, I think we're going to need the Lambent Essence from Neinheart. That thing is really strong! Then, if we could get some Dragon Warrants from the monsters in Leafre, maybe we could combine them to break the wards!

no.0: Do you have a better idea? I'm not really the idea type.

1.0: Did you manage to get all that stuff I asked for? I know it was a lot!

yes.0: I knew I could count on you. Give me just a second and I'll see if I can figure it out!

item.0: We're going to need 1 Lambent Essence and 50 Dragon Warrants to get inside. Hurry, if you have time.
